claim: CloudFront real-time access logs are delivered within seconds to a Kinesis data stream you choose, and you can configure the sampling rate, the fields and the cache behaviors.
question: Where are CloudFront real-time access logs delivered?

values.display: logs are delivered within seconds of receiving
delivered to the data stream of your choice

evidence.quote: With CloudFront real-time access logs, you can get information about requests made to a distribution in real time (logs are delivered within seconds of receiving the requests).
CloudFront real-time access logs are delivered to the data stream of your choice in Amazon Kinesis Data Streams.

claim: Standard logging (v2) can send logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs, Amazon Data Firehose and Amazon S3, while standard logging (legacy) can send logs only to an Amazon S3 bucket.
question: Where can CloudFront standard logs be delivered?

values.display: Amazon CloudWatch Logs, Amazon Data Firehose, and Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3)
You can only send logs to an Amazon S3 bucket

evidence.quote: [Standard logging (v2)](standard-logging.md) – You can send logs to delivery destinations, including Amazon CloudWatch Logs, Amazon Data Firehose, and Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3).
[Standard logging (legacy)](AccessLogs.md) – You can only send logs to an Amazon S3 bucket.

claim: CloudFront automatically publishes operational metrics for distributions and edge functions to CloudWatch, and because CloudFront is a global service the metrics are sent to US East (N. Virginia).
question: In which Region do CloudFront metrics and alarms live?

values.display: automatically publishes operational metrics for distributions and edge
metrics for the service are sent to US

evidence.quote: Amazon CloudFront is integrated with Amazon CloudWatch and automatically publishes operational metrics for distributions and edge functions (both [Lambda@Edge and CloudFront Functions](edge-functions.md)).
Because CloudFront is a global service, metrics for the service are sent to US East (N. Virginia).

the origin didn't respond before the request expired

claim: Lambda@Edge can rewrite URLs and inspect cookies for A/B testing, return different objects by device, generate HTTP responses at viewer or origin request events, and inspect headers or authorization tokens before the request reaches the origin.
question: What can Lambda@Edge do with requests and responses?

values.display: generate HTTP responses when CloudFront viewer request

evidence.quote: A Lambda function can inspect cookies and rewrite URLs so that users see different versions of a site for A/B testing.
A Lambda function can generate HTTP responses when CloudFront viewer request or origin request events occur.
A function can inspect headers or authorization tokens, and insert a header to control access to your content before CloudFront forwards the request to your origin.
